Package com.nutri_sci.model

Class SwapSuggestion

java.lang.Object
com.nutri_sci.model.SwapSuggestion
public class SwapSuggestion extends Object
Represents a food swap suggestion generated by the SwapEngine.

A SwapSuggestion contains all the information needed to present a food swap recommendation to the user, including the suggested food item, its nutritional impact, and a scoring assessment. The class provides detailed breakdowns of how the swap would affect the user's nutritional intake both in absolute terms and as percentages.

This data-holding class is immutable to ensure consistency during the swap evaluation and presentation process.

    • SwapSuggestion

      public SwapSuggestion(String foodName, String foodGroup, double finalScore, Map<String,Double> nutrientChanges, Map<String,Double> nutrientPercentChanges)
      Constructs a new swap suggestion with complete nutritional analysis.
      Parameters:
      foodName - the name of the suggested food item
      foodGroup - the food group category (e.g., "Meat and Alternatives", "Vegetables")
      finalScore - the calculated score indicating swap quality (higher is better)
      nutrientChanges - absolute changes in nutrients (e.g., "Protein" -> +5.2)
      nutrientPercentChanges - relative changes as decimals (e.g., "Protein" -> 0.15 for +15%)

      public String toString()
      Returns an HTML-formatted string representation for UI display.
